Common Questions

Frequently asked questions

How much does a typical renovation cost?

It depends on size and finishes, but most of our kitchens run $45,000–$95,000, bathrooms $22,000–$48,000, and finished basements $55,000–$110,000. Your free consultation ends with an itemized written quote, so you will know exactly where every dollar goes before deciding anything.

Do you handle permits and inspections?

Yes. We prepare and submit City of Ottawa building permit applications, coordinate all required inspections, and make sure electrical and plumbing work is done by licensed trades with their own permits and ESA certificates where required.

How long will my project take?

A typical bathroom takes 3–4 weeks, a kitchen 6–8 weeks, and a basement 8–10 weeks once work begins. Your contract includes start and completion dates, and your project manager sends weekly progress updates with photos.

Can we live in the house during the renovation?

In most cases, yes. We seal off the work area with dust barriers, protect your floors and furniture, and keep a tidy site. For full-home renovations we will talk honestly about whether a short stay elsewhere makes the project faster and less stressful.

What warranty do you offer?

Every project is covered by our 5-year workmanship warranty in writing, on top of manufacturer warranties on materials and fixtures. If something we installed fails because of how we installed it, we come back and make it right at no cost.

How do payments work?

We use a clear milestone schedule tied to progress — a deposit to book your start date, payments as defined stages are completed, and the final balance only after your walkthrough. You never pay for work that has not been done.
